steps.title: Stack on marker 3
steps.rule: Stack tight on waymark 3, the south neurolink, so the whole party is together for Seventh Umbral Era and the tank LB.

steps.title: Walk back after the knockback
steps.cue: Seventh Umbral Era knocks you back
steps.rule: Walk straight back onto waymark 3 and stay stacked for the Calamitous Flame raidwides.

steps.title: Pick up Bahamut Prime
steps.rule: Bahamut Prime sits in the centre and turns to the main tank north of him: stack just south of him, behind his back, so Flare Breath's cone on the main tank misses you.

MainTank.rule: Stand 3m north of the centre (waymark 4) to pick him up and take Flare Breath and Flatten facing away from the party.
